author: Bonerjamer24
quote:
As someone who has played a lot of GTA (written by Dan Houser), I can honestly say that this story, is pure BS. They could have done something interesting with it, but it just doesn't fit into this world. It's frustrating to play a game where every decision you make has an impact on the story, yet you're constantly being told what you can and can't do. You can't steal in your own neighbourhood, you can't shoot people in a club, you can't do this, you can't do that... but apparently, you can be a cuck for 65 hours straight. I don't even want to mention the gameplay and performance. 

Thx for this slop.
